claims_list.descripcion: ACLS revenue declined 18% YoY from $1.02B (FY2024) to $839M (FY2025), with EBIT declining 43% from $211M to $119M, indicating a cyclical trough in ion implantation equipment demand. FY2023 peak was $1.13B revenue / $266M EBIT.
claims_list.brecha_expectativas: Se requiere normalización operativa para converger con expectativas implícitas del mercado.

claims_list.descripcion: Gross margin remained resilient at 44.9% in FY2025 vs 44.7% in FY2024 and 43.4% in FY2023 despite significant revenue decline, suggesting structural cost discipline and pricing power rather than permanent margin erosion.
claims_list.brecha_expectativas: Si esta resiliencia se combina con volumen, puede cerrar rápido la brecha de FCF.

evidencia_actual.cita: margen_bruto_pct FY2025: 44.91%.
FY2024 gross profit 454,654,000 sobre ingresos 1,017,865,000.

claims_list.descripcion: The market implies ~8% FCF CAGR over 5 years under central assumptions (10% discount, 3% terminal growth, 15x terminal multiple), requiring FCF to grow from $107M to ~$153M. La valoración actual exige crecimiento material de FCF.
claims_list.brecha_expectativas: El precio descuenta recuperación de caja; si no aparece, el múltiplo actual queda exigente.

evidencia_actual.cita: Escenario 10%/3%/15x implica CAGR FCF 7.56% y FCF año 5 152,830,000.

claims_list.descripcion: ACLS has a pending merger with Veeco Instruments (merger agreement Sep 2025), which could fundamentally alter the standalone investment thesis.

evidencia_actual.cita: Shareholder approval of Axcelis-Veeco merger confirmed via 8-K.
Pendiente fusión con Veeco: si se cierra, análisis standalone pierde relevancia.

claims_list.descripcion: Balance sheet is very strong with negative net debt (-$80M), no traditional financial debt, and only $44M in finance lease obligations. La política de asignación de caja importa para creación de valor.

evidencia_actual.cita: deuda_total_usd 43,674,000; caja_usd 123,512,000.
deuda_neta_usd: -79,838,000.

claims_list.descripcion: R&D spending increased from $97M (FY2023) to $109M (FY2025) despite revenue declining 26%, indicating continued investment in next-generation ion implantation technology.

evidencia_actual.cita: R&D $109M in FY2025 vs $97M FY2023, rising share of revenue.

claims_list.descripcion: EV/EBIT of 19.6x on trough earnings vs 13.4x on normalized EBIT (~$175M) suggests the market already partially prices in cyclical recovery but not a full return to peak.

evidencia_actual.cita: EV/EBIT 19.6x trough vs 13.4x normalized.

claims_list.descripcion: Q4-2025 revenue of $238M showed sequential improvement from Q3-2025 ($214M), a potential early signal of cyclical bottoming.

evidencia_actual.cita: Q4-2025 revenue $238M vs Q3-2025 $214M, 11% sequential improvement.

claims_list.descripcion: La conversión de utilidad a caja es positiva anualmente (CFO $118M vs NI $120M en FY2025), pero volátil trimestralmente (Q4-2025 CFO -$6.6M vs NI $34.3M).
La intensidad de capital de trabajo es alta (AR $203M, inventarios $282M, AP $47M; WC $438M) y ofrece palanca relevante de FCF si se gestiona.

evidencia_actual.cita: working_capital_usd: 438,446,000.
